$comment: Gate-clause wiring register. Seeded 2026-08-25 from the E0..E11 exit-gate audit.
wired   = a production path reaches the named symbol; the checker verifies it and fails on 0.
unwired = honestly dormant; reason must say what would have to change. Reported on green runs.
Claiming wired when nothing calls it is the defect this register exists to make impossible.

E3-5-product-approval.reason: JOB-010..014 parity bridge. Zero production callers; the legacy approval path still owns this. Wire when the sinks cut over (Sprint 6, MIG-005/006/007 ACTIVE).

E3-15-budget.reason: Parity bridge with zero callers; budget/cost still flow through the legacy cost-event path. Wire at sink cutover (Sprint 6).

E3-17-output.reason: JOB-014 output projection has zero callers; task_outputs is still written by the legacy path. Wire at sink cutover (Sprint 6).

E3-18-revocation.reason: revokeExecutionTarget writes a pending row, but the fanout that ACTS on it has zero callers, so a revoked target is not actively torn down. Needs a scheduler/consumer; sequence with Sprint 3 (dispatch live) since it only bites once workers run.

E4-1-leases-through-protocol.reason: PROMOTED ON EVIDENCE — Sprint 5 Step 1 (CLI-006/D2). packages/worker-daemon/src/__tests__/composed-journey.component.test.ts drives composeDispatchRuntime with its REAL factories through ONE lease: createPollLoop polls, self-checks the frozen offer, and ACKs over the real lease-ack POST (fake.ackCountFor(lease)===1 for the offered lease), then hands off to a supervised run. This is 'a composed loop that took a lease in this sprint's suite' — never caller count. The traversal is the REAL protocol (real pollOnce, frozen leaseOfferV1Schema, real ackLease, a device proof the counterparty verifies INDEPENDENTLY); the counterparty is the protocol-faithful in-process control-plane double (support/fake-control-plane.ts), not real E2B. The SERVER-side leasing/placement that mints the offer is proven separately on the D1 lane (CLI-006, 40/40) + server/src/__tests__/job-leasing.integration.test.ts. Mutation-proven non-vacuous (CLI-006-D2-step1-result.md §3): M0 (positive control) reddens the whole test; M1 (skip the ACK POST) reddens ONLY this E4-1 lease case while the E4-2 supervise case stays green; M2 (remove the handoff) is the mirror — E4-1 green, E4-2 red. The full DISTRIBUTED journey on REAL E2B remains E7-1 (unwired).

E4-2-supervises-sandboxes.reason: PROMOTED ON EVIDENCE — Sprint 5 Step 1 (CLI-006/D2). In composed-journey.component.test.ts a REAL ACK (poll-loop trackHandoff after ackLease) reaches createSupervisor, which runs the sandbox lifecycle create -> execute (tenant command INSIDE the sandbox) -> destroy (provider ops === [create,execute,destroy]) and drains a digest-valid terminal event. It also redeems the CLI-007-minted provider_key handle into spec.env (fail-closed when denied). This is an actually-supervised sandbox reached after an ACK — the exact bar this clause named. The sandbox is the per-op fake provider (support/fake-provider.ts, implements SandboxProvider); a REAL E2B sandbox is E7-1 (unwired). Mutation-proven (CLI-006-D2-step1-result.md §3): M2 (remove trackHandoff) reddens ONLY this E4-2 supervise case while the E4-1 lease case stays green; M3 (drop synthesiseRunSecrets) reddens the credential + fail-closed cases; M5 (no-op the drain) isolates the stream.

E4-3-survives-restart.reason: DEFERRED (WRK-008 slice 2b §4.2), for ONE blocker: StartupReconcilerDeps.leaseCandidates (supervisor/startup-reconcile.ts:256-257) has no durable local source — the outbox persists EVENTS, not offers, so the lease-authority probe would run over [] every boot (a guard that passes because it evaluated nothing). ownershipSelector.organizationId is NOT a blocker — it is on the self-model this slice reads and the frozen schema guarantees it non-null for org/owner-scoped targets. E4-3 waits on a durable lease-candidate source (finding E4-F009).

E4-4-event-outbox-replay.reason: Genuinely wired by WRK-008 slice 2b: composeDispatchRuntime opens the outbox store, recovers it (uploading->pending) at composition, and runtime.start() runs drain.start() at boot — independently of leasing or ACK. 'Reachable' here means reachable FROM A BOOT ROOT, not 'runs by default': dispatch is still off by construction (default-OFF flag). True without qualification.

E5-3-patch-quarantine.reason: Zero callers. Its sibling runOrphanQuarantine now has a producer (startup-reconcile) but that reconciler itself has no caller, so the clause is blocked on E4 wiring (Sprint 3), not on E5.

E5-5-redaction.reason: DAT-008 slice 5 (go-book Sprint 4) gives redaction a real INPUT and a production caller. The old symbol createFenceAwareEgressProxy was the DAT-005 EGRESS proxy (Direction B), which DAT-008's Direction A (env + sandbox_local_only) never uses; re-pointed to the worker function that redeems the handle and returns the values that become per-run canaries. synthesiseRunSecrets is referenced by composeDispatchRuntime (dispatch-runtime.ts) behind the default-OFF flag, and the redaction is PROVEN by a planted-leak test on BOTH streams (supervisor-secret-materialization.test.ts: a seeded secret in a lifecycle log AND in a fence-close network_denied is scrubbed to the marker; an unseeded control leaks it verbatim). What remains for Sprint 5 is a real sandbox authenticating over live E2B (parent DAT-008 design §9 limit 3) — the wiring checker reads caller count, not this field, so that residual lives in the test evidence.

E7-1-coding-journey.reason: DEP-010 (Sprint 2) gives the desktop composition root a dependency path and a one-file construction seam (packages/worker-keystore/src/bin/sandbox-provider.ts) -- the 2 references below are that seam: its ProviderModule interface property and the `new mod.E2bSandboxProvider(...)` construction. STILL UNREACHABLE in a shipped boot: construction requires AOA_WORKER_SANDBOX_PROVIDER=e2b plus AOA_WORKER_E2B_TEMPLATE, and even a provider-bearing daemon composes no supervisor -- bin/worker-daemon.ts:347-349 has no `else` on dispatch.compose. Promote when WRK-008 slice 2b (Sprint 3) composes the loop; the coding journey is proven in Sprint 5. The number is typed out, not computed, so a later reference still fires unwired_but_now_has_caller.

E8-1-sandbox-local-browser.reason: packages/browser-runtime has zero importers and is in no dependency list. The 1 known reference is runner.ts calling it INSIDE the package; runner.ts is the in-guest entrypoint and nothing stages it, so the capability is unreachable despite the non-zero count. Blocked on dispatch (Sprint 3) then BRW-004+ (Sprint 7).

E10-1-drain.reason: Zero callers, and it calls assertRollbackSafe(organizationId) where every implementation takes a companyId. Fix and wire during sink cutover (Sprint 6).

E11-5-provider-kill-switch.reason: Genuinely wired: called on the real poll path (job-leasing.ts) and by the warm-sandbox reaper. Residual, recorded in the wave doc: no write path (throwing it means hand-executed SQL) and it is instance-wide per provider with no Organization or sink dimension - REL-005 scope.
